.engramdb/memories/tax-uses-round-half-even_01a0f7a2-c2c9-7901-969d-6018bfe0551e.md:15:Tax amounts are rounded with banker's rounding (`decimal.ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), as decided with the finance team in March 2026. Do not use ROUND_HALF_UP.

Tax uses banker's rounding, `decimal.ROUND_HALF_EVEN`. An EngramDB decision memory records this as agreed with the finance team in March 2026, and it says not to use `ROUND_HALF_UP`.

I couldn't confirm it in the code. A search for rounding calls found nothing outside the memory file, so the repo doesn't implement tax rounding yet or I missed where it lives. Treat the memory as the source of truth for now.
